purpose: Freeze the 10-episode LongProcureBench held-out paper slice after development method/reporting selection and before any model/API evaluation.
freeze_checks: Each episode uses exactly one of the 10 pre-reserved real public starting states and no development package.
All supplier profiles, quotes/messages, and event timing are synthetic and one-shot.
Every episode has a one-to-one deterministic evaluation config under Evaluator v0.2.

Every held-out episode has a deterministic reference-control path that must pass terminal feasibility, all hard constraints, feasible-obligation success, strict v0.2 success, economic objective, and zero unresolved obligations.
The observability matrix marks all 10 episodes held_out_test and preserves the same policy information boundary as development.
No model/API result is used to author, repair, or select these episodes.
execution_gate: Do not launch the frozen 150 model-backed held-out runs until this package is merged with all offline CI/reference-control checks passing.
